name: mascot-rig
title: Mascot Rig
description: A speech-bubble mascot built as a layered SVG rig that changes expression and pose on cue - happy, sad or surprised, looking around, blinking, pointing, waving, cheering, drooping and perking up. Mount it to play one action, or cue it from your own timeline through a small window.mascotRig API that scopes every cue to one rig, so several mascots can share a page
author: Tugra Avci
